species.description: Quiescent pancreatic stellate cells in tumor compartment. In normal pancreas, PSCs store vitamin A and maintain stromal homeostasis.

species.name: V_T.iCAF
species.description: Inflammatory cancer-associated fibroblasts. Secrete IL-6 and CCL5, driving MDSC recruitment and M2 polarization. Favored when TGFb is low (Biffi 2019, Elyada 2019).

species.name: V_T.myCAF
species.description: Myofibroblastic cancer-associated fibroblasts. Secrete ECM, CXCL12, TGFb, VEGF. Build desmoplastic barrier. Favored by TGFb signaling (Biffi 2019).

species.name: V_T.apCAF
species.description: Antigen-presenting cancer-associated fibroblasts. Express MHC-II, present tumor antigen tolerogenically -> Treg induction. Rarest subtype ~2-5% of CAFs (Elyada 2019).

species.name: V_T.ECM
species.description: Extracellular matrix (collagen, fibronectin, hyaluronic acid) in tumor (total mass in mg). Drives desmoplastic reaction, impairs T cell motility, induces T cell exhaustion. Effective MW ~300 kDa (collagen type I).

species.name: V_T.PDGF
species.description: Platelet-derived growth factor in tumor compartment. Key activator of PSCs and driver of CAF proliferation.

species.name: V_T.CXCL12
species.description: CXCL12/SDF-1 chemokine secreted by iCAFs. Major T cell exclusion mechanism in PDAC via CXCR4 signaling (Elyada 2019, Ogawa 2021).

species.name: V_T.IL6
species.description: Interleukin-6 inflammatory cytokine secreted by iCAFs. Promotes MDSC recruitment, M2 polarization, tumor progression.
